response.justification: While Bogdan has extensive software engineering experience, strong architectural skills, and a demonstrated passion for mentoring, he falls significantly short of the minimum requirement of 8 years of C++ experience. His background is heavily focused on TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with only a brief 7-month stint using C++ professionally, making him an unsuitable fit for a C++ intensive Cloud Compute Tech Lead role.
strengths: Extensive 15+ year background in software design, architecture, and full-stack development.
Demonstrated commitment to engineering best practices, including TDD, CI/CD, and trunk-based development.
Strong mentoring and knowledge-sharing track record through organizing workshops, dojos, and open-source contributions.
concerns: Critically lacks the required 8 years of C++ programming experience, possessing less than a year of professional exposure.
Experience is predominantly in web and application layers rather than core cloud compute platforms or low-level network infrastructure.
Lacks formal experience specifically mentoring DevOps engineers or managing a dedicated cloud infrastructure team.
